summary: Backend-only verification of the two image-batch fixes (durability/auto-resume + migration-aware missing query) plus regression and a live single-batch smoke. 34/34 pytest cases pass (7 durability + 12 prayer + 10 canon + 5 new live regression). Mongo state doc image_batch_state._id='singleton' exists and contains every expected field with is_running=False and stopped_reason='Stopped by admin request.' exactly as the main agent described. Live smoke: POST /api/admin/image-batch/generate (single-batch, auto_continue=false) started, generated 6 real location images in ~2 min with failed=0 and last_error=null, then POST /api/admin/image-batch/stop returned 200 and the persisted doc closed out cleanly (is_running=False, iterations_run=1, generated=6, failed=0). auto_continue was NOT re-enabled.

minor.issue: State is only persisted at the END of a batch (and at kick-off/finish) — heartbeat_at stayed frozen at started_at for the whole 90s window while the in-memory status already showed generated=4. If the process dies mid-batch, up to 25 images' counters (generated/failed/last_results) are lost from the persisted doc even though the images themselves are saved. resume_if_needed also never actually inspects heartbeat_at for staleness despite the docstring claiming it does. Suggest persisting every N images (or every image) and using heartbeat_at in the orphan check.

Cosmetic: stopping a single-batch run records stopped_reason='Single-batch run complete.' instead of 'Stopped by admin request.' — the should_stop break inside generate_batch_sync is overwritten by the unconditional single-batch reason. Admins cannot tell a truncated run from a completed one.

Not a defect, but the requested assertion 'NEW count < OLD count' does NOT hold on current prod data: cities OLD=0/NEW=0, locations OLD=764/NEW=764, and zero docs currently have image_id set with image_url unset (all 7 cities with image_id still retain image_url). The fix is therefore latent/preventive, verified logically instead (unit test test_missing_query_treats_image_id_as_has_image + direct sampling: 5 cities with image_id — wymroost, crares, folis, azure, dravuns-pike — are all excluded by the NEW query). Also note the review request's expectation that 'vargath' (aigraels) has an image_id is wrong: vargath has NO image_id field.

action_items: OPTIONAL (minor): persist batch state more frequently than once-per-batch and actually use heartbeat_at in resume_if_needed's orphan detection.
OPTIONAL (cosmetic): set stopped_reason='Stopped by admin request.' when should_stop truncates a single-batch run.
critical_code_review_comments: city_location_image_batcher.py:_persist_state is only called at kick-off, after each full batch, and in the finally block — heartbeat granularity is ~25 images (~8 min), so mid-batch crash loses counters and any future staleness check would be coarse.
resume_if_needed rehydrates should_stop from Mongo; safe today only because kick_off_background_batch resets it. Keep that invariant if the resume path is refactored.

Batcher still writes multi-MB base64 into cities.image_url / locations.image_url rather than going through ImageService.store_bytes + image_id, so every generated doc will later be migrated (and the doc bloat / churn persists). The new MISSING_QUERY makes this safe cost-wise, but writing image_id directly would be cleaner.

rca_of_the_issue: Both iteration_23 defects are addressed. (1) Durability: job state is now upserted to image_batch_state._id='singleton' at kick-off, after each batch and in the finally block, and a FastAPI startup hook calls CityLocationImageBatcher.resume_if_needed(db), which re-kicks only when the persisted doc had is_running=True AND auto_continue=True AND survey shows remaining work; restore_from never inherits is_running. Verified by 7 unit tests plus the observed real behaviour: my writing of a new test file under /app/backend triggered a uvicorn reload and, because the prior run was cleanly stopped, no spurious resume occurred. (2) Money-burn: MISSING_QUERY now $and's the image_url conditions with equivalent image_id conditions, so migrated docs (image_id set, image_url $unset) are excluded — currently latent since no doc is in that state yet, but proven by unit test and by sampling image_id-bearing cities.
